stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: 得氣與行針的操作要素。

steps.title: 候氣：靜候與感知
steps.objective: 進針後靜候針感出現。
steps.objectiveEn: After insertion, wait for the needle sensation.
steps.instruction: 進針至預定深度後持針不動 10–30 秒，觀察病人表情與局部肌肉微收縮；詢問酸、麻、脹、重。
steps.instructionEn: Hold still 10–30 s at depth; watch the patient's face and local muscle twitch; ask about soreness, numbness, distension, heaviness.
steps.observation: 記錄針感出現時間。
steps.observationEn: Record the time of onset.
steps.failure: 急於行針會掩蓋自然得氣。
steps.failureEn: Manipulating too early masks natural deqi.
steps.check: 能描述得氣感。
steps.checkEn: Can describe deqi.

knowledge.title: 術者感
knowledge.text: 「如魚吞鉤」：針下沉緊感。
knowledge.textEn: 'Like a fish taking the hook': the sense of tightness under the needle.

quiz.question: 「候氣：靜候與感知」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Waiting for qi'?
options: 針感方向可控。
留針安全完成。
準備清單完成。
能描述得氣感。
optionsEn: Direction controlled.
Retention completed safely.
Preparation checklist complete.
Can describe deqi.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 催氣：提插與捻轉
steps.objective: 以小幅手法引出得氣。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi with small-amplitude manipulation.
steps.instruction: 提插幅度 0.3–0.5 cm、捻轉角度 90–180°、頻率 60–90 次／分；交替使用，避免單向捻轉纏繞肌纖維。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust 0.3–0.5 cm, twirl 90–180° at 60–90/min, alternating; avoid unidirectional twirling that winds muscle fibres.
steps.observation: 觀察針感是否出現或傳導。
steps.observationEn: Observe onset or propagation.
steps.failure: 單向大幅捻轉造成滯針與疼痛。
steps.failureEn: Large unidirectional twirling causes stuck needles and pain.
steps.check: 得氣出現。
steps.checkEn: Deqi obtained.

knowledge.title: 循經感傳
knowledge.text: 沿經脈傳導的針感與療效相關。
knowledge.textEn: Sensation travelling along the channel correlates with effect.

steps.title: 行氣：導引針感方向
steps.objective: 使針感向病所傳導。
steps.objectiveEn: Direct the sensation toward the diseased site.
steps.instruction: 針尖朝病所，以押手按壓針後方（阻其退路），配合呼吸與輕捻。
steps.instructionEn: Point the tip toward the site, press behind the needle with the supporting hand to block the backward path, coordinate with breathing and gentle twirling.
steps.observation: 記錄傳導距離。
steps.observationEn: Record propagation distance.
steps.failure: 強求傳導而加重刺激會造成暈針。
steps.failureEn: Forcing propagation with heavier stimulation causes fainting.
steps.check: 針感方向可控。
steps.checkEn: Direction controlled.

knowledge.title: 氣至病所
knowledge.text: 《針灸大成》的行氣法。
knowledge.textEn: The qi-moving methods of the Zhenjiu Dacheng.

steps.title: 補瀉手法選擇
steps.objective: 依證型施以補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Apply tonifying, reducing or even method by pattern.
steps.instruction: 虛證：輕插重提、慢進快退、順經、呼進吸出、出針按壓；實證反之；平補平瀉為均勻提插捻轉。
steps.instructionEn: Deficiency: gentle thrust/heavy lift, slow in/fast out, with the channel flow, insert on exhale, press after withdrawal; excess the reverse; even method is uniform manipulation.
steps.observation: 記錄所用手法。
steps.observationEn: Record the method used.
steps.failure: 手法與證型相反會加重症狀。
steps.failureEn: A method opposite to the pattern worsens symptoms.
steps.check: 手法與辨證一致。
steps.checkEn: Method matches the pattern.

knowledge.title: 燒山火與透天涼
knowledge.titleEn: Burning mountain fire and penetrating heaven cool
knowledge.text: 複式手法的三層分部操作。
knowledge.textEn: Complex methods operating in three depth layers.

steps.title: 留針期間的再行針與觀察
steps.objective: 留針期間維持適度刺激並監測病人。
steps.objectiveEn: Maintain stimulation and monitor during retention.
steps.instruction: 每 5–10 分鐘行針一次 10–20 秒；觀察面色、出汗、頭暈；隨時可拔針處理暈針（平臥、保暖、溫水）。
steps.instructionEn: Manipulate every 5–10 minutes for 10–20 s; watch colour, sweating and dizziness; be ready to remove needles for fainting (lie flat, warm, warm water).
steps.observation: 記錄不良反應。
steps.observationEn: Record any reaction.
steps.failure: 離開病人視線是暈針事故的共同因素。
steps.failureEn: Leaving the patient unobserved is common to fainting accidents.
steps.check: 留針安全完成。
steps.checkEn: Retention completed safely.

knowledge.title: 電針替代
knowledge.text: 可提供穩定持續刺激。
knowledge.textEn: Provides steady continuous stimulation.

steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。

steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.

steps.objective: 能說明並執行「耳穴分區」在耳針與耳穴貼壓中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Auricular zones' within Auricular acupuncture and seed pressing, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「耳穴分區」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Auricular zones': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「耳穴分區」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Auricular zones'.
steps.failure: 若「耳穴分區」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Auricular zones' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「耳穴分區」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Auricular zones' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「耳穴分區」是耳針與耳穴貼壓的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Auricular zones' is a core component of Auricular acupuncture and seed pressing; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：耳穴分區」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Auricular zones'?
options: 已正確完成「耳穴分區」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「交感」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: 'Auricular zones' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'sympathetic' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Preparation checklist complete.

quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Interpretation and decision-making'?
options: 準備清單完成。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
已正確完成「淺刺快針與疳積點刺」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Preparation checklist complete.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'Shallow rapid needling and Sifeng pricking' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 品質、錯誤與安全回顧
steps.objective: 回顧常見錯誤與安全事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Review common errors and safety events.
steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。
steps.instructionEn: List pre-analytical/analytical/post-analytical (or before/during/after) error sources and prevention.
steps.observation: 完成一份自我檢核表。
steps.observationEn: Complete a self-audit checklist.
steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。
knowledge.textEn: No-blame reporting drives system improvement.

optionsEn: Preparation checklist complete.
